name: com.hidano.oscdesk
description: OscDesk (LAN-only OSC control surface) receiver for Unity. Dispatches received OSC addresses to UnityEvents, answers /sys/ping with /sys/pong and echoes values back to the OscDesk bridge. Self-contained OSC 1.0 codec and UDP transport, no external dependencies. No authentication: use only on a trusted LAN.

samples.description: A scene with one OscReceiver (listen 7090, reply 127.0.0.1:7091) and a matching OscDesk surface definition.
